description:
## Finding

\`ChatBackend::apply_space_metadata_patch\` at backend.rs:553-555
invites validation:

> Backends MAY validate the values further (e.g. reject
> \`iconBlobId\` referencing a non-existent blob) and surface
> those as [\`SetError\`] returns.

But \`SetErrorType\` is a \`#[non_exhaustive]\` enum in
\`jmap-server\` with at least these variants potentially applicable
to a blob-not-found rejection:

- \`SetErrorType::InvalidProperties\` (RFC 8620 §5.3 property
  validation failure)
- \`SetErrorType::BlobNotFound\` (if it exists — RFC 8620 §5.3
  defines a \`blobNotFound\` *method-level* error, but whether
  there's an analogous \`SetErrorType\` is unstated by the chat-
  server rustdoc)
- \`SetErrorType::NotFound\` (generic catch-all)

The third-party implementer either:

1. Picks one (probably wrong; RFC 8620 §5.3 puts \`blobNotFound\`
   at the *method* level, not the SetError level — so wrapping
   it in a SetError is itself a spec deviation), or
2. Reads RFC 8620 §5.3 directly to disambiguate, in which case
   the doc didn't help.

## Why this matters

\`iconBlobId\` is named in the doc as the worked example. A
third-party implementer trying to follow the example precisely
hits the SetErrorType-selection ambiguity on the first try. The
doc invites the validation but doesn't close the loop on how to
report the result.

The same gap applies to any value-level validation the trait
allows the backend to perform — the doc gives the green light to
validate but not the format to report the rejection.

## Recommendation

Add a sentence after the existing prose:

> For blob-not-found specifically: use
> \`BackendSetError::SetError(SetError::with_type(SetErrorType::InvalidProperties)
>   .with_properties([\"iconBlobId\"]))\`
> per RFC 8620 §5.3. (\`blobNotFound\` is a method-level error,
> not a SetError variant — surface it as a property validation
> failure at the SetError level.)

Or, more generally, point at a \"Backend implementer's guide\" doc
page (which would also satisfy the broader gap noted in .59) that
covers SetErrorType selection systematically.

## Engineering basis

Direct read of backend.rs:553-555. RFC 8620 §5.3 cross-reference
verified from spec knowledge per AGENTS.md (the spec lives at
\`~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/references/rfc8620.txt\` and defines
\`blobNotFound\` as a method-level error not a SetError variant).
title: API contract: apply_space_metadata_patch invites SetError validation but doesn't specify which SetErrorType for blob-not-found / invalid properties
